instruction: look at thread_plate.step. Create drilling and thread-milling operations for the six M8 tapped holes. Drill the pilot holes, then thread mill each hole to Z=0.000 mm using arcs or a helical approximation. Tool definitions: T1 drills the M8 pilot holes; T2 is a thread mill used to create the M8 internal threads with helical or arc motion. In the NC Program or post-process dialog, use metric units and the selected post processor for this setup, then export task-18.nc to the Desktop path(s) using exactly these absolute file paths.
